_comment: t-143 stage-2 composition (round 3): one-desk corner, data-driven. Consumes stage-1's frozen sprites byte-identical, no pixel edits. Round-3 changes vs b46d686 are LAYOUT ONLY (world size + object x/y): (1) wall-monitor clustered directly above the desk workstation in the agent's forward sightline, not stranded over empty wall; (2) world tightened so the wall headroom and floor apron read as intentional negative space framing one composed corner, not a desk adrift in a void. Sprites untouched (byte-identical to stage 1). seam_y is where the wall plane meets the floor plane. Every object's y is its TOP edge; 'anchor: bottom' objects sit with their bottom edge on seam_y (grounded). Stage 3 consumes this file and only swaps desk-agent's sprite between idle-anchor.png / typing-0..3.png to animate; composition stays frozen.

objects.note: mounted on the back wall directly above/behind the desk workstation, in the seated agent's forward sightline, so wall element + desk read as ONE furniture cluster (matches the reference's corkboard-over-workstation grammar). Height leaves a believable gap above the agent's head.

self-contained agent+chair+desk+CRT unit per t-141's MANIFEST.md. Bottom edge (y+h=seam_y) grounded on the seam; a small floor apron reads in front. Stage 3's frame table swaps this sprite between idle-anchor.png and typing-0..3.png; x/y/plane/anchor stay frozen.
